trip_title: Relaxed Winter Photography Trip: Nagano (Zenko-ji + Snow Monkeys) — Dec 3–4
summary: This 2-day Nagano itinerary keeps things relaxed and centered on your priorities: temples for photography, snow monkeys, and local food. You’ll have a dedicated morning for Jigokudani and flexible temple time, with warm breaks built in for December cold.

days.title: Dec 3 — Zenko-ji temple area + local food photography
days.morning: Zenko-ji Temple area for relaxed walking and photography; explore the surrounding temple-town lanes for winter street scenes.
days.afternoon: Quiet, indoor or slower segment around the Zenko-ji area (temple history/museum time if desired), plus optional gentle stroll between Nagano city centre and the temple zone for photos.
days.evening: Dinner in central Nagano focused on local dishes (e.g., regional specialties like oyaki and local soba if available) and a short evening photo walk for warm storefront lights.

days.title: Dec 4 — Snow Monkeys at Jigokudani + final food stop
days.morning: Go to Snow Monkey Park (Jigokudani Yaen-koen) in the morning for the main snow monkey viewing and photography. Keep a flexible rhythm in case monkeys are active only at certain times.
days.afternoon: Continue the park at your own pace and return toward Nagano city with time for a relaxed reset before dinner.
days.evening: Final local-food meal in central Nagano plus a last short night photo walk near the station/city centre.

tips: Budget note: you said flights and hotel are already booked, so the €300 budget is treated as meals + local transport + entry fees + small daily extras.
December planning: start early (short daylight), dress in layers, and build in warm breaks between photo sessions.
Snow monkey photography: expect cold and condensation—keep a lens cloth handy and protect your camera when moving between warm indoors and outdoors.
Food strategy for a relaxed pace: plan one sit-down local meal per day and fill the rest with smaller snacks/desserts so you can keep moving and photographing.
savings_tips: Do the more “scheduled” part first each day (Zenko-ji early on Day 1, snow monkeys early on Day 2) to avoid spending time and money later.
Use snack-hopping (local treats) instead of multiple expensive meals; it also adds variety for photography.
Limit extra rides: stay in the city centre except for the dedicated snow monkey day trip.
